what: every endpoint with negative slack in the routed timing analysis (after the router) of the seeds of the 311d5689 DDR3 matvec sweep that miss 83.33 MHz; an analysis, not a build
tool: nextpnr-xilinx 0.9.7 (0eae9fbb) with the local logging patch below, run as the sweep's command line with NEXTPNR_PRINT_NEG_SLACK=1; the patch only logs, and each run's FASM sha256 equals the sweep's for the same seed (fasm_equals_sweep), so the placements and routes are the sweep's
source: the cell's src attribute in the netlist (first file:line); part: UberDDR3 controller (ddr3_controller.v), loader (fpga_ddr3_loader.v, the t27 loader's on_clock block or a function), device matvec (fpga_ddr3_matvec.v), feed (fpga_matvec_feed.v)
